findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas used shortened Icelandic side labels instead of the established gagnstæða hlið and aðliggjandi hlið terms.
evidence: The explanatory text used full hlið terms while the formulas displayed only gagnstæða and aðliggjandi.
findings.resolution: Expanded all three visible formulas to the established Icelandic side terminology.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas used shortened Icelandic side labels that differed from the surrounding explanation.
evidence: The inverse formulas omitted hlið although the section consistently defined the side terms with hlið.
findings.resolution: Aligned all three inverse formulas with the established Icelandic side terminology.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used abbreviated side labels instead of the terms used in the Icelandic explanation.
evidence: The example labels omitted hlið while the surrounding text used the full Icelandic side terms.
findings.resolution: Expanded both example labels to gagnstæða hlið and aðliggjandi hlið.
